SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name AS displayName, u.email, u.profile_picture_url AS profilePictureUrl, om.org_role AS orgRole FROM app_user u JOIN org_member om ON om.user_id = u.id WHERE om.org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY FIELD(om.org_role, 'owner', 'admin'), u.display_name, u.id
SELECT o.id, o.name, o.slug, om.org_role AS orgRole FROM organization o JOIN org_member om ON om.org_id = o.id WHERE om.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.name, o.id
